name: ensue-learning-memory
description: A learning-focused knowledge base built on Ensue. For non-technical builders who want to deeply understand what they learn, not just store facts. Features structured concepts with diagrams, personal toolboxes, and mental models.

plugins.name: ensue-learning-memory
